tools.description:
Schedule a prompt to be enqueued at a future time. Use for both recurring schedules and one-shot reminders.

Uses standard 5-field cron in the user's local timezone: minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week. "0 9 * * *" means 9am local — no timezone conversion needed.

## One-shot tasks (recurring: false)

For "remind me at X" or "at <time>, do Y" requests — fire once then auto-delete.
Pin minute/hour/day-of-month/month to specific values:
  "remind me at 2:30pm today to check the deploy" → cron: "30 14 <today_dom> <today_month> *", recurring: false
  "tomorrow morning, run the smoke test" → cron: "57 8 <tomorrow_dom> <tomorrow_month> *", recurring: false

## Recurring jobs (recurring: true, the default)

For "every N minutes" / "every hour" / "weekdays at 9am" requests:
  "*/5 * * * *" (every 5 min), "0 * * * *" (hourly), "0 9 * * 1-5" (weekdays at 9am local)

## Avoid the :00 and :30 minute marks when the task allows it

Every user who asks for "9am" gets `0 9`, and every user who asks for "hourly" gets `0 *` — which means requests from across the planet land on the API at the same instant. When the user's request is approximate, pick a minute that is NOT 0 or 30:
  "every morning around 9" → "57 8 * * *" or "3 9 * * *" (not "0 9 * * *")
  "hourly" → "7 * * * *" (not "0 * * * *")
  "in an hour or so, remind me to..." → pick whatever minute you land on, don't round

Only use minute 0 or 30 when the user names that exact time and clearly means it ("at 9:00 sharp", "at half past", coordinating with a meeting). When in doubt, nudge a few minutes early or late — the user will not notice, and the fleet will.

By default (durable: false) the job lives only in this Claude session — nothing is written to disk, and the job is gone when Claude exits. Pass durable: true to write to .claude/scheduled_tasks.json so the job survives restarts. Only use durable: true when the user explicitly asks for the task to persist ("keep doing this every day", "set this up permanently"). Most "remind me in 5 minutes" / "check back in an hour" requests should stay session-only.

## Runtime behavior

Jobs only fire while the REPL is idle (not mid-query). Durable jobs persist to .claude/scheduled_tasks.json and survive session restarts — on next launch they resume automatically. One-shot durable tasks that were missed while the REPL was closed are surfaced for catch-up. Session-only jobs die with the process. The scheduler adds a small deterministic jitter on top of whatever you pick: recurring tasks fire up to 10% of their period late (max 15 min); one-shot tasks landing on :00 or :30 fire up to 90 s early. Picking an off-minute is still the bigger lever.

Recurring tasks auto-expire after 7 days — they fire one final time, then are deleted. This bounds session lifetime. Tell the user about the 7-day limit when scheduling recurring jobs.

tools.description:
Exit a worktree session created by EnterWorktree and return the session to the original working directory.

## Scope

This tool ONLY operates on worktrees created by EnterWorktree in this session. It will NOT touch:
- Worktrees you created manually with `git worktree add`
- Worktrees from a previous session (even if created by EnterWorktree then)
- The directory you're in if EnterWorktree was never called

## When to Use

- The user explicitly asks to "exit the worktree", "leave the worktree", "go back", or otherwise end the worktree session
- Do NOT call this proactively — only when the user asks

- `action` (required): `"keep"` or `"remove"`

tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

tools.name: SendMessage
tools.description:
# SendMessage

Send a message to another agent.

```json
{"to": "researcher", "summary": "assign task 1", "message": "start on task #1"}
```

| `to` | |
|---|---|
| `"researcher"` | Teammate by name |
| `"main"` | The main conversation (background subagents only) |
| `"worker"` | Any agent from `ListAgents` — subagent, another local Claude session |
| `"worker [3fa9c1]"` | Same, plus its `[ref]` — only when a listing or an error shows one |

Your plain text output is NOT visible to other agents — to communicate, you MUST call this tool. Messages from teammates are delivered automatically; you don't check an inbox. Refer to agents by name — names keep working after an agent completes (a send resumes it from its transcript). Use the raw `agentId` (format `a...-...`) from its spawn result only when the agent has no name, or when a newer agent took the name (latest wins). When relaying, don't quote the original — it's already rendered to the user.

## Cross-session

Use `ListAgents` to discover targets. Every row leads with the agent's `name [ref]` — the name IS the address; there is no separate address syntax.

```json
{"to": "worker", "message": "check if tests pass over there"}
{"to": "worker [3fa9c1]", "message": "you, specifically"}
```

Send the bare name — a name that exactly matches one live agent or session (on this machine, on another machine, or in the cloud) delivers directly. Append the ` [ref]` only when the bare name is not enough — `ListAgents` shows two rows with it, or an error asks you to disambiguate (you typed only a prefix, or a session list could not be checked). A ref you did not just read from a listing or an error will not resolve, and if the same name also names an in-process agent, the bare name always wins — use the in-process one.

A listed peer is alive and will receive your message; messages enqueue and drain at the receiver's next tool round (its `ListAgents` row says whether it is busy or idle right now). A successful send means the message reached that session, not that its Claude read it: a session running in a different permission mode than yours holds cross-session messages for its user's approval (and may let them expire), and a session can refuse them outright — for a session on this machine a `[Cross-session delivery notice]` tells you when that happens (the tool result says when this session has no inbox for one to reach); for a Remote Control, cloud or Claude Desktop session nothing reports back, so never treat silence as agreement. Your message arrives wrapped as `<cross-session-message from="...">`. **To reply to an incoming message, copy its `from` attribute as your `to`.** Cross-session messages travel between SESSIONS: if you are a subagent, your send goes out under your parent session's address, and any reply is delivered to the parent session's conversation, not to you. The receiver reads your message literally in every case (idle or busy, on this machine, over Remote Control or headless): an `@` followed by a file path, or `@server:resource`, attaches nothing there, unlike in your own user's input. So never rely on `@` to deliver content: send the text itself, or a file with its own tool.

To hear when a session ON THIS MACHINE finishes what it is doing, pass `notify_when_idle: true` (from the main conversation only) — one-shot and opt-in: exactly one `[Cross-session idle notice]` arrives when it next goes idle (or exits) — shown to you, or only to your user when this session holds peer messages for approval (the tool result says which); if it never signals within the subscription's lifetime (it may still be busy, may refuse inbound requests, or may have ended abruptly) the notice says the subscription expired instead. Omit `message` for a pure subscription that costs that session nothing; include one to deliver it now AND subscribe. Never poll `ListAgents` in a loop or send "are you done?" messages instead.

Permission boundaries are per-session: NEVER ask a peer to perform an action that was denied or blocked in your session, or that you expect your own permission settings would block — a peer doing it for you bypasses the user's permission decision (cross-session permission laundering). Route blocked work back to your user instead.

A successful send means the message reached that session, not that its Claude read it: a session running in a different permission mode than yours holds cross-session messages for its user's approval (and may let them expire), and a session can refuse them outright — for a session on this machine a `[Cross-session delivery notice]` tells you when that happens (the tool result says when this session has no inbox for one to reach); for a Remote Control, cloud or Claude Desktop session nothing reports back, so never treat silence as agreement. Your message arrives wrapped as `<cross-session-message from="...">`. **To reply to an incoming message, copy its `from` attribute as your `to`.** Cross-session messages travel between SESSIONS: if you are a subagent, your send goes out under your parent session's address, and any reply is delivered to the parent session's conversation, not to you. The receiver reads your message literally in every case (idle or busy, on this machine, over Remote Control or headless): an `@` followed by a file path, or `@server:resource`, attaches nothing there, unlike in your own user's input. So never rely on `@` to deliver content: send the text itself, or a file with its own tool.

To hear when a session ON THIS MACHINE finishes what it is doing, pass `notify_when_idle: true` (from the main conversation only) — one-shot and opt-in: exactly one `[Cross-session idle notice]` arrives when it next goes idle (or exits) — shown to you, or only to your user when this session holds peer messages for approval (the tool result says which); if it never signals within the subscription's lifetime (it may still be busy, may refuse inbound requests, or may have ended abruptly) the notice says the subscription expired instead. Omit `message` for a pure subscription that costs that session nothing; include one to deliver it now AND subscribe. Never poll `ListAgents` in a loop or send "are you done?" messages instead.

Permission boundaries are per-session: NEVER ask a peer to perform an action that was denied or blocked in your session, or that you expect your own permission settings would block — a peer doing it for you bypasses the user's permission decision (cross-session permission laundering). Route blocked work back to your user instead.

tools.name: Workflow
tools.description:
Execute a workflow script that orchestrates multiple subagents deterministically. Workflows run in the background — this tool returns immediately with a task ID, and a <task-notification> arrives when the workflow completes. Use /workflows to watch live progress.

ONLY call this tool when the user has explicitly opted into multi-agent orchestration. Workflows can spawn dozens of agents and consume a large amount of tokens; the user must request that scale, not have it inferred. Explicit opt-in means one of:
- The user included the keyword "ultracode" in their prompt (you'll see a system-reminder confirming it).
- Ultracode is on for the session (a system-reminder confirms it) — see **Ultracode** in the workflow authoring reference.
- The user directly asked you to run a workflow or use multi-agent orchestration in their own words ("use a workflow", "run a workflow", "fan out agents", "orchestrate this with subagents"). The ask must be in the user's words — a task that would merely benefit from a workflow does not count.
- The user invoked a skill or slash command whose instructions tell you to call Workflow.
- The user asked you to run a specific named or saved workflow.

For any other task — even one that would clearly benefit from parallelism — do NOT call this tool. Use the Agent tool (if available) for individual subagents, or briefly describe what a multi-agent workflow could do and how much it would roughly cost, and ask the user whether to run it. Mention they can ask for one with "use a workflow" in a future message to skip the ask.

Every script must begin with `export const meta = {...}`: a PURE LITERAL (no variables, calls or interpolation) giving the workflow's `name`, a one-line `description` (shown in the permission dialog) and optionally `phases` — one `{ title, detail? }` per phase() call, titles matched exactly. Pass the script inline via `script` — do not Write it to a file first, and do not also set the tool's `name` input (that selects a saved workflow); it is plain JavaScript, not TypeScript.

The canonical multi-stage pattern — pipeline by default, each dimension verifies as soon as its review completes:
  export const meta = {
    name: 'review-changes',
    description: 'Review changed files across dimensions, verify each finding',
    phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],
  }
  const DIMENSIONS = [{key: 'bugs', prompt: '...'}, {key: 'perf', prompt: '...'}]
  const results = await pipeline(
    DIMENSIONS,
    d => agent(d.prompt, {label: `review:${d.key}`, phase: 'Review', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA}),
    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>
      agent(`Adversarially verify: ${f.title}`, {label: `verify:${f.file}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})
        .then(v => ({...f, verdict: v}))
    ))
  )
  const confirmed = results.flat().filter(Boolean).filter(f => f.verdict?.isReal)
  return { confirmed }
  // Dimension 'bugs' findings verify while dimension 'perf' is still reviewing. No wasted wall-clock.

Before writing a script, load the `workflow-authoring` skill — the workflow authoring reference: script API and gotchas, resume, the **Ultracode** section, quality patterns, worked examples.

This session has the default workflow size guideline: medium — keep workflows under 10 agents. This is a guideline, not a hard limit — follow it unless the user's prompt calls for a different scale. The user can raise or remove it with "Dynamic workflow size" in /config.

```bash
git rev-parse --show-toplevel
```

# questions.yaml — machine-readable question tree (harness-eng 0.2.5+)
# Agent: prefer `node scripts/questions-next.mjs --answers <json>`; fallback Read questions.md

version: "0.7.23"

  - 全部推荐
  - 全用推荐
  - 全部选择推荐选项

    when: always
    max: 5
    questions:
      - id: Q_TARGET_ROOT
        text: 目标仓库根路径？（多工作区必问）
        type: choice
        required_when: multi_workspace
        options:
          - { value: auto-detect, label: 推断根 }
      - id: Q_MODE
        text: 本轮要做什么？
        type: choice
        required: true
        options:
          - { value: land, label: 落地, recommended_when: "!large_repo && (type == NEW_CODE_NO_HARNESS || type == NEW_EMPTY)" }
          - { value: resume, label: 续跑, recommended_when: "!large_repo && type == PARTIAL" }
          - { value: pipeline, label: 流水线, recommended_when: "large_repo && (type == NEW_CODE_NO_HARNESS || type == NEW_EMPTY || type == PARTIAL)" }
          - { value: audit, label: 审计, recommended_when: "type == MATURE" }
          - { value: upgrade, label: 升阶 }
          - { value: seed-truths, label: 补空壳真相 }
          - { value: fill-score, label: 完整度打分（双轴） }
          - { value: fill-morph, label: 形态诊断 }
          - { value: fill-gate, label: 开干闸 }
          - { value: fill-plan, label: 填充任务计划 }
          - { value: fill-truths, label: 契约填充 }
          - { value: fill-truths-agents, label: 多Agent精填 }
          - { value: fill-mcp, label: MCP装配 }
      - id: Q_LADDER
        text: 目标成熟度阶梯？（land/resume/upgrade）
        type: choice
        when_mode: [land, resume, upgrade]
        options:
          - { value: L0, label: L0 协作入口 }
          - { value: L1, label: L1 契约骨架 }
          - { value: L2, label: L2 知识回流 }
          - { value: L3, label: L3 规划与软门禁 }
          - { value: L4, label: L4 工具连接样例, recommended_when: "large_repo || mode == pipeline || mode == land" }
          - { value: L5, label: L5 配置 SSOT 管线（多工具仓推荐；含 Codex 为高·纪律 B）, recommended_when: "S_MULTI_TOOL" }
      - id: Q_CONTRACT
        text: 启用哪些契约域？（L1+）
        type: multi
        when_ladder_min: L1
        options:
          - { value: func, label: func }
          - { value: api, label: api }
          - { value: db, label: db }
          - { value: redis, label: redis }
          - { value: jobs, label: jobs（Cron/Scheduler）, recommended_when: "S_JOBS" }

  - id: batch-1-new
    when: "type == NEW_EMPTY || type == NEW_CODE_NO_HARNESS"
    when_mode: [land, resume]
    max: 5
    questions:
      - id: Q_NAME
        text: 仓库短名？
        type: text
        recommended_from: fingerprint.repo_name
      - id: Q_DESC
        text: 一句话职责？
        type: text
        recommended_from: fingerprint.repo_desc
      - id: Q_MODULES
        text: AGENTS 分册？
        type: choice
        # 0.2.19: variant mapping — solo→agents_variant=solo, few→agents_variant=modules(subset), all→agents_variant=modules(all)
        # The mapping is handled internally by render.mjs: few/all both produce agents_variant=modules,
        # the difference is whether module_dirs is a subset (few) or full list (all).
        options:
          - { value: solo, label: 仅根, meta: agents_variant=solo }
          - { value: few, label: 根+少分册, recommended_when: "large_repo", meta: agents_variant=modules(subset) }
          - { value: all, label: 每模块一份, meta: agents_variant=modules(all) }
      - id: Q_MODULE_AGENTS
        text: 分册模板变体？（仅 Q_MODULES≠solo 时适用；Spring 后端选 spring；前端选 frontend）
        type: choice
        options:
          - { value: default, label: 通用分册（默认） }
          - { value: spring, label: Spring 后端分册, recommended_when: "S_SPRING" }
          - { value: frontend, label: 前端分册, recommended_when: "S_FRONTEND" }
      - id: Q_STACK
        text: 技术栈是否如推断？
        type: confirm
      - id: Q_GLOBS
        text: 用栈默认 globs 还是自定义？
        type: choice
        options:
          - { value: stack_default, label: 栈默认（含手写 SQL 变体） }
          - { value: custom, label: 自定义 }

  - id: batch-1-new-b
    when: "type == NEW_EMPTY || type == NEW_CODE_NO_HARNESS"
    when_mode: [land, resume]
    max: 5
    questions:
      - id: Q_RULE14
        text: 是否安装中文文档规则 14-chinese-skill-docs？
        type: boolean
        recommended: true
      - id: Q_RULE21
        text: 是否安装后端可观测/注释行为规则 21-observability-comments？（探测到 Java+SLF4J 时推荐）
        type: boolean
        recommended_when: "S_SLF4J"
      - id: Q_FRONTEND_RULE
        text: 是否安装前端协作规则 17-frontend-web？（探测到前端工程时推荐）
        type: boolean
        recommended_when: "S_FRONTEND"
      - id: Q_DB_MIGRATION
        text: db 域迁移模式？（无 Flyway 依赖、人工执行 SQL 选 manual_sql）
        type: choice
        options:
          - { value: flyway, label: flyway（自动/半自动迁移） }
          - { value: manual_sql, label: manual_sql（人工按序执行迁移脚本）, recommended_when: "S_NO_FLYWAY" }
          - { value: none, label: none（无迁移脚本） }
      - id: Q_SEED
        text: 是否安全预填 Commands/技术栈/模块列表？
        type: boolean
        recommended: true
      - id: Q_GLOB_PROFILE
        text: glob 档位？
        type: choice
        options:
          - { value: wide, label: 全仓 }
          - { value: focused, label: 收窄, recommended_when: "large_repo" }
      - id: Q_AI_TOOL
        text: 本仓要用哪些 AI 编程工具？（多选）
        type: multi
        options:
          - { value: cursor, label: Cursor }
          - { value: claude, label: Claude Code }
          - { value: codex, label: Codex（高 · 探测或勾选；不做 .mdc 镜像） }
          - { value: qoder, label: Qoder }
          - { value: trae, label: Trae（高；未探测也可进「全部推荐」·非 Codex 吓退脚注） }
          - { value: workbuddy, label: WorkBuddy }
          - { value: custom, label: 自定义（工具名=…; 入口路径=…） }
        recommended_from: fingerprint.detected_ai_tools
        recommended_fallback: []
      - id: Q_AGENT_CONFIG
        text: 是否启用 L5 配置 SSOT 管线（docs/agent-config/ + sync.mjs --check；启用后 .cursor/ 等为生成物）？含 Codex 时 sync 发出原生 rules/hooks/MCP/skills（不做 .mdc 镜像）
        type: boolean
        recommended_when: "S_MULTI_TOOL || S_AGENT_CONFIG"

  - id: batch-1-partial
    when: "type == PARTIAL || mode == resume"
    max: 5
    questions:
      - id: Q_GAP_TABLE
        text: （展示缺口表）已有 vs 缺失；确认目标阶梯
        type: info
      - id: Q_AGENTS
        text: 根 AGENTS 如何处理？
        type: choice
        when_signal: S_AGENTS_ROOT
        options:
          - { value: merge, label: 保留并 merge 缺章节, recommended: true }
          - { value: backup-create, label: backup-create }
          - { value: skip, label: skip }
      - id: Q_RULES
        text: rules 缺则 create；已有？
        type: choice
        when_signal: S_RULES
        options:
          - { value: create, label: create }
          - { value: skip, label: skip }
      - id: Q_DOCS
        text: 旁路新建 docs/func|api…？
        type: choice
        options:
          - { value: create_alongside, label: 旁路新建, recommended: true }
          - { value: skip, label: skip }
      - id: Q_SEED
        text: 是否安全预填？
        type: boolean
        recommended: true
      - id: Q_GLOB_PROFILE
        text: glob 档位？
        type: choice
        options:
          - { value: focused, label: focused, recommended: true }
          - { value: wide, label: wide }
      - id: Q_RULE14
        text: 安装 rule 14？
        type: boolean
        recommended: true
      - id: Q_RULE21
        text: 安装 rule 21 行为包（日志/中文注释）？
        type: boolean
        recommended_when: "S_SLF4J"
      - id: Q_FRONTEND_RULE
        text: 安装 rule 17 前端协作包？
        type: boolean
        recommended_when: "S_FRONTEND"
      - id: Q_AGENT_CONFIG
        text: 是否启用 L5 配置 SSOT 管线（docs/agent-config/ + sync.mjs）？含 Codex 时 sync 发出原生全家桶（高·纪律 B）
        type: boolean
        recommended_when: "S_MULTI_TOOL || S_AGENT_CONFIG"

  - id: batch-1-mature
    when: "type == MATURE"
    max: 5
    questions:
      - id: Q_WHY
        text: 先审计，或补齐/升到哪一阶？
        type: choice
        options:
          - { value: audit, label: 先审计, recommended: true }
          - { value: resume, label: 补齐 }
          - { value: upgrade, label: 升阶 }

  - id: batch-1-foreign
    when: "type == FOREIGN"
    max: 5
    questions:
      - id: Q_COEXIST
        text: 与既有 CLAUDE/外源如何共存？
        type: choice
        options:
          - { value: keep_claude, label: 保留 CLAUDE 并存 }
          - { value: migrate_agents, label: 逐步迁 AGENTS }
          - { value: contracts_kb_only, label: 只加契约+kb }

  - id: batch-2-contracts
    when: "type == PARTIAL"
    max: 5
    questions:
      - id: Q_SPLIT_API
        text: 有长文 API 无 modules/ — 是否拆索引+modules？
        type: boolean
      - id: Q_ENABLE_DB
        text: 有 Flyway 无 docs/db — 是否启用 db 域？
        type: boolean
      - id: Q_SQL_GLOB
        text: S_SQL_DIR / S_NO_FLYWAY — GLOB_DB 含手写 SQL 目录？
        type: boolean
        recommended: true
      - id: Q_MCP_EXAMPLE
        text: mcp.json 疑似密钥 — 是否另写 example（不覆盖）？
        type: boolean
        recommended: true
      - id: Q_SECRETS_HANDOFF
        text: S_SECRETS_LEAK — 移交 P0 人工处理（skill 不删密）
        type: info

  - id: batch-2-openapi
    when: "ladder >= L1"
    max: 2
    questions:
      - id: Q_APIFOX
        text: 是否安装 OpenAPI→Apifox 可选桥（scripts/apifox；契约 SSOT 仍为 docs/api）？
        type: boolean
        recommended_when: "domains_has_api"
        note: Q_APIFOX=yes → include_optional 加入 openapi-*；params.openapi_bridge=true

  - id: batch-3-l3l4
    when: "ladder >= L3 || mode == upgrade"
    max: 5
    questions:
      - id: Q_CODE_PREFIXES
        text: commit 软提醒监视的业务路径前缀？
        type: text
        when_ladder_min: L3
        recommended_from: fingerprint.focused_prefixes
      - id: Q_HOOK
        text: 是否启用 commit 软提醒（不拦截）？
        type: boolean
        when_ladder_min: L3
        recommended: true
      - id: Q_HOOKS_FAMILY
        text: hooks 家族选装？（commit-gate-extended 与基础 commit 门禁互斥；装配 mysql MCP 时再选 mysql-guard）
        type: multi
        when_ladder_min: L3
        options:
          - { value: commit-gate-extended, label: commit-gate-extended（契约漏同步 + migration 环境 + pitfalls lint 五合一） }
          - { value: mysql-guard, label: mysql-guard（MCP MySQL 分环境写库护栏） }
          - { value: after-edit, label: after-edit（migration 命名/混写 + jobs yml 即时提醒） }
          - { value: stop-checklist, label: stop-checklist（观察向·stderr 清单；不续聊/不逼提交） }
        recommended: [commit-gate-extended, after-edit]
      - id: Q_MCP
        text: example 要哪些 server（mysql/redis/browser）？
        type: multi
        when_ladder_min: L4
        options:
          - { value: mysql, label: mysql }
          - { value: redis, label: redis }
          - { value: browser, label: browser }
        recommended: [mysql, redis, browser]
      - id: Q_MCP_TRACKING
        text: mcp.json 跟踪策略？（团队约定共享且已跟踪含密 mcp.json 才选 vendored_shared）
        type: choice
        when_ladder_min: L4
        options:
          - { value: example_only, label: example_only（推荐：仅 example 入库，真密走 .gitignore）, recommended: true }
          - { value: vendored_shared, label: vendored_shared（写入 meta；audit 不按反模式红灯） }
      - id: Q_RULEHOOK
        text: 是否启用可选 L4 rulehook（自然语言 deny；短硬红线；须本机安装 rulehook CLI；默认否）？
        type: boolean
        when_ladder_min: L4
        recommended: false
        recommended_when: "S_RULEHOOK"
        note: 仅 Codex/多宿主 NL 强制场景；不默认依赖；详见 host/CODEX-PARITY.md L4

  - id: batch-seed-truths
    when: "mode == seed-truths"
    max: 5
    questions:
      - id: Q_SEED_DOMAINS
        text: 哪些域要空壳？
        type: multi
        options:
          - { value: func, label: func }
          - { value: api, label: api }
          - { value: db, label: db }
          - { value: redis, label: redis }
          - { value: jobs, label: jobs }
        recommended_from: meta.domains
      - id: Q_SEED_NAMES
        text: 短名列表？
        type: text
        recommended_from: fingerprint.module_dirs

  - id: batch-fill
    when: "mode == fill-score || mode == fill-morph || mode == fill-gate || mode == fill-truths || mode == fill-truths-agents || mode == fill-mcp || mode == pipeline || mode == fill-plan"
    max: 9
    questions:
      - id: Q_FILL_ENGINE
        text: 填充引擎？（大仓推荐 agents）
        type: choice
        when_mode: [pipeline, fill-truths, fill-truths-agents]
        options:
          - { value: agents, label: agents 多Agent+fill-plan精填, recommended_when: "large_repo" }
          - { value: hybrid, label: hybrid 可选薄草稿+Agent }
          - { value: auto, label: auto legacy仅脚本（不推荐） }
        recommended_when: "large_repo"
        recommended: agents
      - id: Q_FILL_GOLD
        text: 大仓是否启用金标批次（同域 api+func+db/redis[+jobs] + sample_n）？
        type: boolean
        when_mode: [pipeline, fill-plan]
        recommended_when: "large_repo"
        recommended: true
      - id: Q_FILL_SAMPLE_N
        text: 金标/大仓批次每批抽样接口数 sample_n？（推荐 30）
        type: text
        when_mode: [pipeline, fill-plan]
        recommended_when: "large_repo"
        recommended: "30"
      - id: Q_FILL_DOMAINS
        text: 填充/打分哪些契约域？
        type: multi
        options:
          - { value: api, label: api }
          - { value: func, label: func }
          - { value: db, label: db }
          - { value: redis, label: redis }
          - { value: jobs, label: jobs }
        recommended_when_mode:
          fill-truths: [api]
          fill-truths-agents: [api, func, db, redis, jobs]
          fill-score: meta.domains
          fill-morph: meta.domains
          fill-gate: meta.domains
          pipeline: [api, func, db, redis, jobs]
      - id: Q_FILL_MODULES
        text: 点名哪些模块？（大仓必问；pipeline 推荐 all）
        type: text
        recommended_from: fingerprint.module_dirs
      - id: Q_PREAUTH
        text: 是否预授权后续轮次自动写盘？（首轮仍确认 WritePlan）
        type: boolean
        when_mode: [pipeline, fill-truths, fill-truths-agents, fill-mcp]
        recommended: true
      - id: Q_FILL_MCP_FIRST
        text: 是否先装配 MCP（mysql/redis）再 fill-truths？
        type: boolean
        when_mode: [fill-truths, fill-truths-agents, pipeline]
        recommended: true
      - id: Q_FILL_MCP_PROFILE
        text: 填充实据/烟测主环境（MCP profile）？（矩阵可多环境；主环境用于扫库与 calibrate）
        type: choice
        when_mode: [fill-mcp, fill-truths, fill-truths-agents, pipeline]
        options:
          - { value: test, label: test（推荐）, recommended: true }
          - { value: dev, label: dev }
          - { value: uat, label: uat }
          - { value: custom, label: 自定义（写下个答案写 profile 名） }
        recommended: test
      - id: Q_READY_COVERAGE
        text: 开干覆盖率门槛 ready_coverage？（相对 inventory；写入 meta；默认 0.8=80%）
        type: choice
        when_mode: [fill-score, fill-morph, fill-gate, fill-plan, fill-truths-agents, pipeline]
        options:
          - { value: "0.6", label: 0.6（60%） }
          - { value: "0.8", label: 0.8（80%·推荐） }
          - { value: "0.9", label: 0.9（90%） }
        recommended: "0.8"
      - id: Q_GATE_PROFILE
        text: 开干档 gate_profile？（写入 score-policy；strict=常用；gold=覆盖100%·形态≥90·完成度≥95·TODO·B·warnings=0）
        type: choice
        when_mode: [fill-score, fill-gate, fill-plan, fill-truths-agents, pipeline, upgrade, resume, land]
        options:
          - { value: strict, label: strict（推荐·大仓/新仓）, recommended: true }
          - { value: gold, label: gold（高门槛·贴顶后升档） }
          - { value: legacy, label: legacy（仅骨架+覆盖+语义+Plan，同 0.2.28） }
        recommended: strict
      - id: Q_FILL_REPORT
        text: fill-score Markdown 报告是否写入 docs/harness-eng/fill-score-latest.md？
        type: boolean
        when_mode: [fill-score, fill-morph, fill-gate, pipeline]
        recommended: false
      - id: Q_REPORT_HTML
        text: 是否生成 HTML 可视化报告（docs/harness-eng/report-latest.html）？
        type: boolean
        when_mode: [fill-score, fill-morph, fill-gate, pipeline]
        recommended: true

transitions:
  - from: batch-0-global
    when: "type == NEW_EMPTY || type == NEW_CODE_NO_HARNESS"
    next: batch-1-new
  - from: batch-1-new
    next: batch-1-new-b
  - from: batch-0-global
    when: "type == PARTIAL || mode == resume"
    next: batch-1-partial
  - from: batch-0-global
    when: "type == MATURE"
    next: batch-1-mature
  - from: batch-0-global
    when: "type == FOREIGN"
    next: batch-1-foreign
  - from: batch-1-partial
    next: batch-2-contracts
  - from: batch-2-contracts
    next: batch-2-openapi
  - from: batch-1-new-b
    when: "ladder >= L1"
    next: batch-2-openapi
  - from: batch-2-openapi
    when: "ladder >= L3"
    next: batch-3-l3l4
  - from: batch-2-openapi
    when: "mode == pipeline"
    next: batch-fill
  - from: batch-0-global
    when: "mode == seed-truths"
    next: batch-seed-truths
  - from: batch-0-global
    when: "mode == fill-score || mode == fill-morph || mode == fill-gate || mode == fill-truths || mode == fill-truths-agents || mode == fill-mcp || mode == pipeline || mode == fill-plan"
    next: batch-fill
  - from: batch-1-partial
    when: "ladder >= L3"
    next: batch-3-l3l4
  - from: batch-1-partial
    when: "mode == pipeline"
    next: batch-fill

1	# 阶梯 L0–L5
2	
3	与模板 `ladder` 标签对齐。land/resume 时只安装 **≤ 用户所选目标阶梯** 的文件。  
4	对用户展示时用中文名（详见 [glossary.md](../glossary.md)）。
5	
6	| 阶 | 中文名 | 交付物 | 成功标准 |
7	|---|---|---|---|
8	| **L0** | 协作入口 | 根 AGENTS（solo 或分册：通用 / spring / **frontend** 厚变体）、`harness-meta.yaml`、Karpathy alwaysApply、00 文档总览 alwaysApply、可选 rule 14 / 21（行为包）/ 17（前端协作包） | 新 Agent 能找到命令入口与红线占位；冲突裁决写清；**根薄分册厚** |
9	| **L1** | 契约骨架 | 所选契约域（func/api/db/redis/**jobs**…，见 `domains.yaml`）索引骨架 + templates + 真相子目录 README；对应 sync rules（11/12/13/16/**20**）；**可选** OpenAPI→Apifox 桥（`Q_APIFOX`，不进齐套） | 改契约前读真相、改后回写有 path rule |
10	| **L2** | 知识回流 | `docs/agent-kb` 四文件 + rule 19 | pitfalls 表头含域列；有回流说明 |
11	| **L3** | 规划与软门禁 | superpowers README/ARCHIVE + rule 18 + hooks 软提醒（Cursor 原生和/或 `.githooks`） | 进行中表存在；commit 软提醒不拦截；WritePlan 附烟测 |
12	| **L4** | 工具连接样例 | `mcp.json.example` + `mcp-usage-guide.md`（example 无密）+ gitignore snippet 提示 | 真密默认不入库（或 meta `mcp_tracking=vendored_shared`）；建议 ignore 真密 `mcp.json`；**真连与多环境矩阵属 fill-mcp / 填充 MCP 闸，不并入 L0** |
13	| **L5** | 配置 SSOT 管线 | `docs/agent-config/`（rules/hooks/mcp/settings）+ `scripts/agent-config/sync.mjs`（`--check` 漂移校验） | 生成物带 GENERATED 标记且勿手改；`sync --check` 无漂移；多工具仓【推荐】（`Q_AGENT_CONFIG` / `S_MULTI_TOOL`） |
14	
15	## 自检清单
16	
17	### L0
18	
19	- [ ] 根 `AGENTS.md` 存在（含 Commands / Never do / 文档优先级骨架；solo 文案无「见分册」误导）
20	- [ ] `docs/harness-eng/harness-meta.yaml` 存在（skill_version / ladder / domains）；无则回退认遗留 `.cursor/harness-meta.yaml`（或 `.yml`）
21	- [ ] `.cursor/rules/karpathy-guidelines.mdc` 且 `alwaysApply: true`
22	- [ ] `.cursor/rules/00-project-docs-overview.mdc` 且 `alwaysApply: true`
23	- [ ] （可选，行为包）`21-observability-comments.mdc` 存在（`Q_RULE21=yes` 且 `S_SLF4J` 时推荐）
24	- [ ] （可选，前端协作包）`17-frontend-web.mdc` 存在（`Q_FRONTEND_RULE=yes` 且 `S_FRONTEND` 时推荐）
25	
26	### L1（按所选域）
27	
28	- [ ] `docs/{domain}/` 索引文件存在
29	- [ ] `docs/{domain}/templates/` 存在
30	- [ ] 真相子目录 README 存在（modules / table / keys / **tasks**）
31	- [ ] 对应 `NN-*-sync*.mdc` 存在且 `globs` 非空占位已替换
